candidates.change_summary: Changed the return value from onERC721Received.selector to a different bytes4 value (keccak256('onERC721Received') xor 0x1).
Changed the function to always return the zero bytes4 value (0x00000000).
Remove the assignment `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken retains its default address(0) value.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken is always set to the zero address regardless of the argument.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address.
Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with a constant wrong address so the stored NFT address differs from the initialized value.
Delete the line `nft = _nft;` so the nft state variable retains its default zero address.
Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so the nft state variable is set to the base token address instead.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = factory;` so the nft state variable is set to the factory address.
Replace `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(this);` so the nft state variable is set to the pool's own address.
Remove the assignment to changeFee so the state variable retains its default value of 0 after initialize.
Assign a hardcoded non-zero value (e.g., 1) to changeFee instead of the input parameter _changeFee.
Insert a statement that sets changeFee to a constant value after it is set from the parameter, overriding the parameter value.
Insert a shadowing local variable `uint16 feeRate = 0;` before the state assignment, so the state variable is never set.
Remove the fee-rate-cap check `if (_feeRate > 5_000) revert FeeRateTooHigh();` so that values above 5000 can be stored.
Change `feeRate = _feeRate;` to `feeRate = _feeRate + 1;` so the stored value is always one higher than the requested value.
